name: chess-gantry-tooling
description: Formatting and validation tooling for the chess-gantry project

scripts.format: npm run format:prettier && npm run format:python
scripts.format:check: npm run format:prettier:check && npm run format:python:check
scripts.format:python: uv run python scripts/strip_comments.py --write src tests examples scripts && uv run python -m black .
scripts.format:python:check: uv run python -m black --check . && uv run python scripts/strip_comments.py --check src tests examples scripts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run steering:check && npm run git:hygiene
